body: The Weeknd just released the music video for “Hong Kong,” turning his tribute to the city into a cinematic moment Directed by Evan Larsen, the visual draws on the atmosphere of late ’80s and early ’90s Hong Kong. The song samples Faye Wong’s 1993 classic “Seasonal Wind,” also known as “Monsoon,” connecting his sound with a piece of Cantopop history.

source_caption_text:
The Weeknd just released the music video for “Hong Kong,” turning his tribute to the city into a cinematic moment 🎬🌃🔥

Directed by Evan Larsen, the visual draws on the atmosphere of late ’80s and early ’90s Hong Kong. The song samples Faye Wong’s 1993 classic “Seasonal Wind,” also known as “Monsoon,” connecting his sound with a piece of Cantopop history. 

He first premiered the track and its accompanying visuals during his October 24 show at Kai Tak Stadium—giving fans in Hong Kong the first look before today’s video release 👀🖤
